children: Enova amended its HWCR 2023 revolving receivables securitization facility to $535 million to support ongoing funding needs. The amendment sets Class A commitments at $400 million and Class B at $135 million, with borrowing rates of SOFR + 2.75% and SOFR + 8.50%, respectively, and advance rates up to 87.5%. The revolving period now runs through March 2028, with final maturity in March 2029. The facility is administered by Atlas Securitized Products Administration, with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as paying agent and Vervent as backup servicer.
